text:
Rina Kapoor: Heads-up 1: customer inbox + internal PMs pushed for the Optimize toolkit pilot today. We need to sharpen scope: batching, caching, quant recommendations, plus eval-triggered alerts. Proposal: a minimal, low-risk pilot that still demonstrates cost/quality wins. Quick thoughts?

Sam Lopez: Agree on minimal. Suggest: limit to 2 workload shapes (chat short <=128, doc long 512-2048) and a single region. More variables = noisy metrics.

Maya Patel: From UX: customers asked for a clear explanation of "why" a recommendation was chosen. We should include a short rationale line per recommendation and a link to a deep-dive.

Priya Chen: For eval-alerts: we MUST ship with a labeled baseline and a transparent thresholding strategy. Customers will ask for reproducible checks. My ask: 3 core metrics per tenant (exact-match / BLEU-ish / latency) and seeded regressions to validate alerts.

Ethan Moore: Status update: batching and prefix-caching hooks are merged to canary. Quantization suggestion pipeline is prototype; missing persistent profile store + versioned API. Realistic engineering: 2 dev weeks for store + 1 week to hook advisor API.

Alex Zhang: Operational constraints: no automatic apply for first pilot. We need per-tenant opt-in plus a per-tenant emergency disable (kill switch) and a percent rollout slider. Also require monitoring for token-cost delta and p99 latency tail; if p99 increases >12% we auto-disable for that tenant.

Rina Kapoor: Proposed pilot definition: 
- Customers: 3 pilot tenants (2 midmarket, 1 enterprise)
- Workloads: chat short + doc long buckets (as Sam suggested)
- Model: redwood-verif-7B only
- Mode: advisory-only (no auto-apply) with UI + API surface
- Acceptance gates: persistent quant-profile store, eval baseline + seeded regressions, per-tenant kill-switch + rollout knob, rationale text in recommendation, runbook for false positives
- Success metrics: cost delta binned by seq-length (target 8-18% for long bucket), p95 latency no worse than baseline + 10%, eval-alert precision >= 90% on seeded set

Sam Lopez: Suggest clarifying that the cost target excludes requests < 16 tokens. Those are degenerate for batching.

Priya Chen: OK. For seeded regressions: propose seed_count=40 per tenant, hold-back validation=20, daily sample=400 checks. Also require automatic roll-back if any core metric drops >3 points for >6 hours.

Maya Patel: UI note: recommendation card should include short rationale (<140 chars) + "confidence" and "impact estimate" so customers can judge. Example: "Batch size 4: expected -12% tokens for long docs; risk: small p95 increase"

Ethan Moore: Example advisor payload (read-only):
```
model_family: redwood-verif-7B
tenant_id: acme-123
recommendation: { batch_size: 4, cache: prefix-lru-30m, quant_profile: int8-ld4 }
confidence: 0.78
rationale: "reduces repeated tokens for long doc patterns; safe for majority clients"
impact_estimate: "-12% token cost (512-2048)"
```
We return as text/json and attach impact telemetry over next 24h if enabled.

Alex Zhang: Monitoring baseline: prepilot 7-day baseline window per-tenant. Alerts: >12% p99 regression, >8% error-rate delta, cost delta negative or positive >20%. Also add audit logs for advisor actions.

Rina Kapoor: Timeline proposal: kickoff in 10 business days, infra + UI + eval harness in parallel; gate review at week 5. If gates pass, expand pilot to 10 tenants for beta.

Sam Lopez: I'll confirm pilot customers and their legal/scoped data permission needs.

Priya Chen: I'll assemble the eval prompt set and the seeded regression corpus by EOD Wednesday. Also will outline the rollback automation rules.

Ethan Moore: I'll start the quant-profile store design doc and the advisor API spec today. Will call out storage schema + versioning. ETA: 2 weeks for MVP.

Maya Patel: I'll wire up recommendation UI mock and short rationale copy.

Alex Zhang: I'll add the runbook entries and the deploy-bot blocker to prevent rollouts without kill-switch.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 1799999200 - 1799999999. Will post deploy events.

Rina Kapoor: Thanks team. If no objections, I'll lock this scope and notify sales + customer success to start invitations.

Sam Lopez: :thumbsup: 

Priya Chen: Sounds good.

Ethan Moore: 👍

Alex Zhang: 👍 will open runbook PR.
